timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,400–1,410 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is currently STRONG (only ~1,400 KRW per USD), meaning you need fewer won to get your $2,000—so dollars are cheap right now. However, multiple sources indicate the won is expected to WEAKEN further, with a 93% probability of reaching 1,300 KRW per USD by year-end, meaning dollars will become even cheaper. Buying now locks you in at an unfavorable rate when better rates are likely coming soon.

TIP: Consider delaying or reducing this month's conversion if possible, and wait for the won to weaken toward 1,300 (where your $2,000 will cost significantly more won, but that's when you should buy).
